## Summary

Describe the product or technical change and its scope.

## Validation

List the checks actually executed and their results. State separately whether live upstream data was verified.

## Limitations

Document any known limitations, deployment prerequisites, or compatibility concerns.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Commit messages, descriptions, code, logs, and screenshots are suitable for public release.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, private conversations, or unrelated project details are included.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] Tests and live-data verification are described separately.
